fit_reason: Whole car, a 2016 Hyundai Accent hatchback, listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Red paint on the hood, doors and rear hatch looks clean with good gloss and reflections
Headlights look clear in the front three-quarter photo
Black lower front grille and bumper trim look dark, not faded
Interior is only glimpsed through the windows; no close-up interior photos to judge seats or carpets
message: Hi Jess, we saw your listing for the red Accent hatchback. The paint already looks glossy in your photos, so a light pre-sale wash, wax and interior detail would just keep it looking its best for showings. We come to you. Would you like a quote?
